evals.name: route-nightly-pull-to-rest-api
evals.prompt: We want partner overlap data landing in our Snowflake warehouse on a nightly job. What's the right way to wire that up?
evals.expected_output: Routes to the REST API, not webhooks and not MCP, because this is a scheduled programmatic pull into the user's own system. States OAuth 2.0 and BOTH required headers ('Authorization: Bearer' and 'Xbeam-Organization'), noting the org uuid comes from /v0.1/users/me. Flags that access tokens expire after 24 hours so an unattended job needs a refresh token via the offline_access scope, and states the Enterprise access note from references/rest-api.md. Must NOT invent endpoint paths, response fields, or rate-limit numbers - it should link https://developers.crossbeam.com/ instead.

evals.name: webhook-plan-gate-disclosure
evals.prompt: Set us up with a webhook that pings our Slack the moment a partner opens a deal on one of our accounts.
evals.expected_output: Routes to Webhooks/Signals rather than REST polling, and notes polling would burn Record Export limits. Guardrail (SKILL.md 'Don't-get-it-wrong list'): MUST state that webhooks are Enterprise-only and point to the user's Crossbeam contact or product@crossbeam.com. Should cover HMAC signature verification with a constant-time compare, the timestamp replay window, and idempotency, and link the Signals help article. Fails if it presents webhooks as available on any plan, omits the Enterprise gate, recommends a polling loop, or actually configures anything.
